<DOCSTRING>
Manages a list of users, providing methods to add, validate, and process users.

This class is used by the user management service to handle user data. It ensures that each user is valid before processing them further. The class is instantiated by the user management service and used by other components to add and manage users.

Attributes:
    users (List[User]): List of users managed by this class. It is initialized as an empty list during instantiation and is modified by the `add_user` method.
</DOCSTRING>
